title: Debate Over Kirk Evidence: Owens’ theories face scrutiny on PBD Podcast; Wilson demands proof
summary_full: Candace Owens and Andrew Wilson faced off in a heated debate over the death of conservative activist Charlie Kirk. Owens questioned aspects of the official account and raised theories involving possible foreign involvement, while Wilson challenged her to provide evidence. The discussion also turned personal after Wilson accused Owens of using her phone for answers. Moderator Patrick Bet-David refused to declare a winner, saying, “The people won today.”
